summary: This replication stage executed a thorough three-tier plan, downloaded the 1.9 GB of MUSE vectors and support datasets, and rerun baseline and reconstructed mitigation experiments across Spanish and French. It successfully reproduced ES Original MWEAT (3.6918), word translation P@1/P@5 across all four directions via MUSE nearest-neighbor retrieval, and cos(d_PCA, d_g) (0.3885 vs 0.389). It produced key technical insights, demonstrating that the published ES Shift-Ori 0.3090 reproduces only under the buggy doPCA centering, that orthogonal alignment preserves internal distances so Hybrid-Ori must equal Shift-Ori, and that French Table 1 matches the notebook's stored cell output rather than the published paper. However, it missed the circularity of evaluating mitigation on the shifted words and the uninformative nature of the permutation test statistics, endorsing the paper's qualitative conclusion that bias is substantially reduced.
